outcome: time from preinduction to delivery onset
time from preinduction to vaginal delivery
cohort: 198 patients with an unfavorable cervix (Bishop score < 6) undergoing labor induction preinduction.
finding: Both intracervical Foley catheter and dinoprostone were equally effective in achieving vaginal delivery; however, Foley catheter preinduction led to a longer time to delivery but a shorter post-delivery hospitalization.
mod_finding: Both Foley catheter and dinoprostone preinduction methods were equally effective in achieving vaginal delivery, with no significant difference in vaginal delivery rates between groups.
